objective: Give the professor-related price/SIP factors explicit majority score weight; test preference alignment and quantify predictive/risk tradeoffs without automatic promotion.
interpretation: Score weight is not percentage accuracy, causal importance, or a guaranteed alignment gain. All historical outcomes have already been exposed; this new frozen family is retrospective diagnostics only.

factor90_learned.learner: sklearn Ridge positive=True alpha=10 max_iter=2000 tol=1e-6
factor90_learned.core_weights: 0.1 + 0.5 * normalized nonnegative Ridge coefficient per factor; equal fallback only if every fitted coefficient is zero. Each factor gets >=10percent of core and all core weights sum1.

factors: Five completed calendar-year price-return percentile average, itself percentile-normalized
Inverse age of available-history recorded closing high
Trailing professor-mode whole-share SIP gain divided by actually invested capital
price_features: Frozen provider Close, already split-adjusted, truncated at each decision date; no future rows. Calendar boundaries use last observed close on/before boundary with <=7calendar-day lag. CAGRs use actual observed elapsed days. Annual block needs five complete annual returns, requiring six year-end boundaries. High is available-history closing high, not independently certified lifetime intraday ATH. Most recent exact-tolerance equal high gets latest date.
coverage: One base7500 profile: amount7500,36month lookback,30day contributions,target20percent,forward12months. Classified evidence-positive sector peers, >=5complete stocks, >=80percent active volume, positive-volume lag<=14days, SIP budget utilisation>=50percent, finite whole-share profit>=-1. Every required factor must exist; no neutral imputation or weight redistribution. Incomplete issuers receive an explicit unavailable lens and retain production champion separately.
corporate_actions: Existing unresolved provider/official events at/before decision within retained available history invalidate price factors. Trailing36month events invalidate SIP. Events after decision through endpoint invalidate outcomes, never retroactively change input score or ranking. Current provider adjustment basis and retrospective sectors remain limitations; no new PIT certification.
normalization: Within decision-date/sector complete feature-eligible population, before outcome filtering. Higher percentiles preferred for all factors. Champion is percentile-normalized over that same population. Fixed model coefficient weights apply to these five comparable blocks, not raw incompatible units.
training: Seven fits for learned model: annual2020-2025 endpoint strictly before January1 of prediction year; current frozenOctober3,2026 fit uses endpoint strictly before October3. Equal sector/date training weight. Target0.5within-sector future-XIRR percentile +0.25drawdown percentile +0.25inverse shortfall percentile. At least100mature rows and2decision dates. No hyperparameter search.
evaluation: Development2020-2023, then lock candidate, then exposed2024-2025diagnostics. All periods previously exposed. Same factor-eligible stocks for every candidate and champion. IC uses common finite mature outcomes and>=5valid stocks. Top3 selections occur on full feature cohort; if any candidate's selected stock lacks a guarded outcome, the query's Top3 outcomes are unavailable for ALL candidates, never reselect after removing unknown outcomes. Equal sector then date averages. Report coverage and blocked queries.

development_selection.alignment: Mean of selected Top3's five factor percentiles, equal block weights, then equal sector and date. Descriptive preference fit, partly mechanically circular; not investment accuracy.
development_selection.choice: Highest development alignment gain among candidates passing these fixed point limits, deterministic model-name tie break; otherwise none.

promotion: None automatic. A preference candidate is not an investable replacement without matched portfolio cashflow/cost evidence, source-integrity coverage, prior prospective noninferiority protocol, and fresh daily inputs. Do not use exposed results to change selection, weights, eligibility or thresholds.
runtime: One worker,one compute thread,WindowsCPUhardcap12.5percent,CPU4seconds active/2rest; no GPU fitting, no system power changes. Read large CSVs in20000row chunks and retain base profile only. Preserve cached stage checkpoints and errors.
method_choice: Positive Ridge plus explicit score-mass and per-factor floors makes weights inspectable. A monotonic tree alone constrains direction but does not guarantee a factor weight allocation. Fixed weighted-percentile controls test whether learning is needed. These are project adaptations, not pretrained paper replications or weights prescribed by the professor.
excluded_claims: All profiles or holding horizons tested
Two-percent alignment threshold equals two-percent model weight
